newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Aug budget deficit $41.83 bln.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Aug budget deficit $41.83 bln.

text.p: The U.S. Government posted a budget deficit of $41.83 billion in August, the Treasury Department said Monday, up from a deficit of $33.85 billion in August 1995.
Last month's deficit also was significantly higher than July's shortfall of $27.1 billion.
Treasury said that military active pay, veterans' benefits, and supplemental security income payments scheduled for September 1 were accelerated to August 30, which boosted spending last month.
Total outlays in August were $141.83 billion, up from $130.99 billion in July and up from $130.49 billion in August 1995.
Income fell in August to $99.99 billion from $103.89 billion in July but exceeded the $96.64 billion the government took in from taxes and other sources in August 1995.

During the first 11 months of fiscal 1996 that ends on September 30, the budget deficit totaled $143.96 billion, down 16 percent from the $171.11-billion total posted in the first 11 months of fisal 1995.

The Clinton Administration, anticipating a September surplus, is forecasting a deficit for the full 1996 fiscal year of $116.75 billion. That would be a significant improvement over the fiscal 1995 fiscal deficit total of $163.87 billion.
